faq_heading: Homes near Fraser Heights Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Fraser Heights Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Fraser Heights Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Fraser Heights Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Fraser Heights Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 192 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,400,000, townhomes $725,000, condos $510,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Fraser Heights Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Fraser Heights Secondary the median was 30 days on the market, closing at 96.8% of the list price, with 7% of sales above the list price for the 192 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Fraser Heights Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Erma Stephenson Elementary (0.3 km north-west), Dogwood Elementary (0.7 km west) and Fraser Wood Elementary (0.8 km east).

How the Fraser Heights Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Fraser Heights Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Fraser Heights Secondary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 192 homes sold within 2 km of Fraser Heights Secondary: 90 houses, 55 townhomes and 45 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,400,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Fraser Heights Secondary

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Fraser Heights Secondary in a straight line (12 elementary, 3 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Erma Stephenson Elementary, 0.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is Guildford Park Secondary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Johnston Heights Secondary (2.3 km); the nearest independent school is Pacific Academy (1.8 km). Other secondary schools close by: Johnston Heights Secondary (2.3 km south-west), North Surrey Secondary (2.4 km south), Guildford Park Secondary (3.0 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Johnston Heights Secondary, 2.3 km south-west of Fraser Heights Secondary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Fraser Heights Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Fraser Heights Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Fraser Heights Secondary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 2 km of Fraser Heights Secondary was $1,400,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Johnston Heights Secondary, the nearest other secondary school, 2.3 km south-west of Fraser Heights Secondary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
